verdict.rationale: Fedora ships GNOME Software as a built-in app store advertising one-click install from Fedora repos and Flathub (fedora-docs-8, fedora-docs-12), which matches the story on paper. However, a hands-on community report describes needing 'a whole page of commands' to install popular apps like Discord and Spotify, and installed GUI apps not appearing in the launcher — a concrete contradiction of the frictionless single-click promise. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that one-click install reliably works for mainstream third-party apps, and resolution of the cited failure case.
